sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (18/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but mixed congressional activity (1 buy vs 2 sales, small amounts) and absent news sentiment provide no confirmation.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis (432.8), flat yield curve, rising dollar, imminent FOMC event, and negative macro score create severely adverse conditions for equities despite distant earnings.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme oversold oscillators (RSI 9, Stoch RSI, Williams %R) combined with fear-zone sentiment (18/100) and price near support (265.75) create classic contrarian bounce setup.
